description: Issue #1478 (P1): create ONE enforced pre-launch green gate. No unified gate currently exists on main, but all pieces do. Compose them into a single script scripts/launch-gate.sh wired as npm run launch-gate, chaining: typecheck + lint + unit tests + fresh-migrate dry-run + smoke + health. The gate must be runnable locally and wireable in CI, and must degrade gracefully (clearly SKIP, not silently pass) for stages that need a live DB or running server when those are unavailable. Independent of FEAT-002. Branch: fix/1478-prelaunch-green-gate.
steps: git checkout main && git pull --ff-only, then git checkout -b fix/1478-prelaunch-green-gate.

Create scripts/launch-gate.sh following the existing style of scripts/pre-merge-check.sh and scripts/smoke-test.sh (bash, set -euo pipefail, boxed echo headers, numbered stages, ✅/❌ markers, non-zero exit on any hard failure). Do NOT reimplement logic that already exists -- CALL the existing pieces.
Stage 1 Typecheck: npm run typecheck (hard fail on error).
Stage 2 Lint: npm run lint (hard fail on error).
Stage 3 Unit tests: npm run test:unit (hard fail).

Stage 4 Fresh-migrate dry-run: npx tsx scripts/migrate.ts --dry-run --yes. This needs DATABASE_URL. If DATABASE_URL is unset OR the DB is unreachable, print a clear '⚠ SKIP (no reachable database)' and continue WITHOUT failing the gate, so the gate is runnable on a dev box without a DB. When DATABASE_URL is set and reachable, a dry-run failure is a hard fail.

Stage 5 Smoke test: reuse scripts/smoke-test.sh. It requires a running server on :3000; if the server is not up, print '⚠ SKIP (server not running)' and continue without failing (smoke-test.sh already exits non-zero when no server -- capture that and treat 'server not running' as SKIP, but a genuine smoke assertion failure against a running server as hard fail).

Stage 6 Health check: curl the /api/health endpoint (app/api/health/route.ts, GET returns JSON with status:'ok'). Only run if a server is reachable; otherwise SKIP. Parse for status:ok (and optionally db/schema_ready). Hard fail only if server is up but health is not ok.

Support an env/flag toggle so CI can require the server-dependent stages (e.g. LAUNCH_GATE_STRICT=1 turns SKIPs for stages 4-6 into hard failures) while local runs default to graceful skip. Document this in the script header.
Add npm script: 'launch-gate': 'bash scripts/launch-gate.sh' in package.json scripts.

Optionally wire the gate into CI as a minimal, SAFE addition: either a new small job or a step that calls npm run launch-gate. Keep it minimal, no secret dumping, no echoing of env. If adding/modifying .github/workflows/ci.yml, do it on this branch (it will be delivered via PR, never pushed to main). If uncertain, prefer NOT touching CI and instead document in the script header how to wire it -- the orchestrator can decide.

Verify locally: bash -n scripts/launch-gate.sh (syntax), then run npm run launch-gate on a dev box (no DB/server) and confirm stages 1-3 run and pass, stages 4-6 SKIP gracefully, overall exit 0. Confirm LAUNCH_GATE_STRICT=1 makes the skipped stages fail.
git add scripts/launch-gate.sh package.json (and ci.yml if touched) && git commit -m 'feat(#1478): unified pre-launch green gate (launch-gate)'. Report branch + SHA + whether CI was touched.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/launch-gate.sh exists, passes bash -n, and is executable/runnable via npm run launch-gate.
The gate chains typecheck + lint + unit tests + migrate dry-run + smoke + health in that order with clear per-stage output.

Running npm run launch-gate on a machine with no DB and no server: stages 1-3 execute (and pass on green main), stages 4-6 print explicit SKIP messages, and the gate exits 0 (does not silently claim the skipped stages passed).
LAUNCH_GATE_STRICT=1 converts the DB/server-dependent SKIPs into hard failures so CI can enforce the full gate.
package.json has a 'launch-gate' script. Any CI change is minimal, contains no secret-dumping/env-echo, and lives only on the branch (not pushed to main).
npm run typecheck and npm run lint remain green after the change.
verification: npm run launch-gate  (expect stages 1-3 pass, 4-6 SKIP, exit 0 in sandbox)
LAUNCH_GATE_STRICT=1 npm run launch-gate  (expect non-zero exit because DB/server stages cannot run in sandbox)
findings:
Implemented on branch fix/1478-prelaunch-green-gate, commit 16fa8761. Created scripts/launch-gate.sh (chmod +x, 100755) composing the 6 existing pieces in order: (1) npm run typecheck, (2) npm run lint, (3) npm run test:unit — all hard-fail; (4) npx tsx scripts/migrate.ts --dry-run --yes gated on DATABASE_URL presence + bounded pg_isready reachability probe; (5) scripts/smoke-test.sh gated on a curl --max-time 3 probe of :3000 so its own 'not running' exit never leaks into the gate; (6) GET /api/health parsed for status:ok, only when server reachable. No logic reimplemented — each stage calls the existing target. Added npm script 'launch-gate': 'bash scripts/launch-gate.sh' in package.json. Per-stage pass/skip/fail tracking with a final summary table and totals line; SKIP is explicit and distinct from PASS. Env toggle LAUNCH_GATE_STRICT=1 converts stage 4-6 SKIPs into hard failures for CI; documented in the script header along with optional CI wiring guidance. CI NOT TOUCHED: ci.yml already runs lint/typecheck/unit/integration/build as separate jobs, so a duplicate gate job would be redundant; wiring instructions are documented in the script header for the orchestrator to decide. Files changed: scripts/launch-gate.sh (new), package.json (1 line). VERIFICATION: `bash -n scripts/launch-gate.sh` => SYNTAX_OK. `npm run launch-gate` (sandbox, no DB/server) => stages 1-3 PASS (typecheck clean; lint 0 errors/146 warnings; 5410/5410 unit tests pass across 331 files), stages 4-6 explicit SKIP, exit 0. `LAUNCH_GATE_STRICT=1 npm run launch-gate` => stages 4-6 become hard FAIL, exit 1. npm run typecheck and npm run lint remain green. Note: postman/full-test-suite.sh and the live smoke/health stages cannot execute in this sandbox (no DB, no server) — acceptable per context.json; those stages SKIP gracefully by design. Commit passed husky pre-commit (lint-staged prettier ran on package.json; gitleaks absent -> warning, acceptable). Not pushed, no PR (per constraints).

REFINEMENT (follow-up commit on same branch, addressing review 2026-08-29-035451 issues 1-3): (1) Stage 4 — removed the pg_isready reachability gate. migrate.ts --dry-run reads drizzle/migrations/meta/_journal.json and exits before `new Pool`, so it never connects; the stage now only requires DATABASE_URL to be SET, then runs `npx tsx scripts/migrate.ts --dry-run --yes` and uses its exit code. DATABASE_URL unset => SKIP (graceful) / hard FAIL (STRICT), unchanged. No long-connect risk, so no probe needed. (2) Stage 6 — strengthened from liveness to readiness. app/api/health/route.ts returns top-level "status":"ok" even when db is disconnected/error; the stage now requires all three compact-JSON signals: "status":"ok" AND "db":"connected" AND "schema_ready":true. Server-up-but-not-ready is a HARD fail; SKIP-when-server-down / STRICT-fail-when-server-down behavior unchanged. (3) Header comment + Stage 4/6 map lines + in-stage echoes updated so a green STRICT run no longer over-implies. Preserved set -euo pipefail, record_pass/skip/fail tracking, shared SERVER_UP probe, summary table, exit 0 only when FAIL_COUNT==0, STRICT SKIP->FAIL semantics, and no secret/env-value echoing. VERIFICATION (Node 22): `bash -n scripts/launch-gate.sh` => SYNTAX_OK. `npm run launch-gate` (no DB/server) => stages 1-3 PASS (typecheck clean; lint 0 errors/146 warnings; 5410/5410 unit tests across 331 files), Stage 4 SKIP (DATABASE_URL unset), stages 5-6 SKIP (server down), Totals 3 passed/3 skipped/0 failed, exit 0. `LAUNCH_GATE_STRICT=1 npm run launch-gate` => stages 4-6 hard FAIL, Totals 3/0/3, exit 1. No secret echoed (Stage 4 reports only 'DATABASE_URL is unset', never the value). Refinement commit reported in final response.
